title: Observa CloudEvents Structured JSON Envelope v1
description: Observa's constrained CloudEvents 1.0 structured JSON profile. Published at the Observa public GitHub Pages schema endpoint; released v1 schemas must remain immutable.

specversion.description: CloudEvents specification version; not the Observa payload schema version.

id.description: Stable event identity; reuse for retries of the same logical event.

source.description: Producer-declared event source URI-reference, which ingestion must authorize against the authenticated source registration.

type.description: Observa semantic event category using CloudEvents type.

time.description: Producer-reported occurrence time (RFC 3339). Ingestion adds a separate observed/received timestamp.

subject.description: Optional subject within the source context; do not duplicate business identifiers here unless the producer convention defines it.

dataschema.description: Observa event data schema version. Public payload-schema URL used to identify the Observa data contract version.
